description: This file is a PHP class definition for the 'Latest' module extension in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for displaying and saving module data, managing breadcrumbs, and integrating with the OpenCart MVC framework. The class is part of the extension modules for the admin section and handles backend logic related to the 'Latest' module.

classes.name: Latest
classes.description: Controller class for the 'Latest' module extension in OpenCart, providing functionality for rendering, saving, and managing the module in the admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the 'Latest' module configuration page, set up breadcrumbs, load language and models, and render the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Method to handle saving the module's configuration data via POST request, with permission checks and JSON response.
